basis: Follow-up to known outcomes. Confirm 1-5 MHz as a candidate for suppressing low-frequency background; test response weighting and receiver groups. No parameter sweep over flaw coordinates, no flaw-centred crop, unchanged physical gates and support rules.
candidate_basis: Earlier one-factor evidence suggested a modest gain; validate at 0.1 mm, on reference controls, wider field and source/receiver group ablations. Exploratory confirmation on same known flaw, not held-out validation.
